figures.title: Geometry, production and mean feedback
figures.caption: Completed central cases at 1200 s. The first panel measures q geometry; the other panels measure signed cumulative effects and retain their sign. Normalization uses each run’s own initial background-anomaly enstrophy. Finite perturbations add initial energy. These are distinct finite-time measurements, not regime labels; individual pages retain absolute production and closure residuals.

figures.title: central-re100, seed 1
figures.caption: Direct horizontal-mean Eulerian current (top) and change from each run’s initial profile (bottom). Colors identify initial perturbation energy; they do not assign the subsequent flow a 2D/3D regime. Matched runs have identical base fields. Finite perturbations add energy.

methods.q: q = d_z uL - d_x w - d_z us, Eulerian transverse vorticity.
methods.T: T = q d_y v + d_y w d_x v - d_y u d_z v. T=0 for all y-independent flows, including nonzero v(x,z).
methods.transport: D_L q = T + Dq. The term -v q_y transports q; it is not an additional enstrophy production term.
methods.q0: q0=-alpha d_z us_reference is retained. Its native centered discrete derivative defines a=q-q0.
methods.anomaly: D_L a=T-w q0_prime+Dq; Pa_background=-<a w q0_prime> can change anomaly enstrophy in 2D.
methods.partition: Zq=Zmean+Zvariance; exchange <F·gradQ> has opposite signs in their budgets. 3D production can change their sum.
methods.native_feedback: Curl of full native advection minus advection evaluated on the y-mean field; weighted by Q or Q-q0. Distinct from a continuum Reynolds-stress approximation.
methods.closure: Temporal closure compares observed moments with integrated freshly evaluated native qdot. Spatial closure compares the native rate with continuum production, viscosity, forcing, pressure and face transport. Signed residuals remain visible.
methods.boundary: Full-depth and Stokes-layer budgets use complete cells and stored face transport; layer-base flux is retained.
methods.geometry: Zvariance/Za removes the large prescribed background from the denominator; no threshold is used to assign a regime.
methods.comparison: Horizontal-mean UE=UL-us and its change from own initial profile. Exact 2D, tiny, intermediate and finite initial disturbances use the same base field. Finite disturbances add energy.
methods.limits: Finite-time cases with limited seed and numerical checks. A production or geometric measure alone neither proves a closure nor establishes an oceanic mixing barrier.
